name: Mailbox
description: A message an agent takes in turn (D104): a Workflow on status with fixed states (queued, urgent, taken, sent, canceled, failed), whose sender's moves (to urgent, back to queued, and canceled) the subject the row's createdBy holds makes; StateRules freezing every own field of a taken message; and Lease on a taken message: a taker acquires the row's lease and moves it to taken with the token, and while it is taken the lease's expiry, an abandon or a release moves it back to queued. The table declares createdBy, an own field that holds the sender's subject. A take is the app's: the declared read of a conversation's oldest waiting message, Lease's acquire and the move to taken.

ttlMs.description: How long a taker's lease lasts after its acquire or its last heartbeat, in milliseconds; Lease's 60000 when absent.

takePermission.description: The permission a caller needs to take a message, Lease's acquirePermission; any caller who may write the row when absent.
